research.title: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments comparing standard and importance-weighted split conformal prediction under controlled covariate shifts in synthetic regression data.
Analyzed empirical coverage and interval width across calibration sample sizes, examining sensitivity to density ratio estimation errors.

research.title: Probability Calibration with Noisy Training Labels
bullets: Designed classification experiments varying label corruption mechanisms to compare temperature scaling and isotonic regression on held-out calibration data.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and log loss to distinguish calibration changes from discrimination changes across noise conditions.

research.title: Regularization and Feature Selection with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Designed simulation experiments comparing ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression across predictor correlation structures and signal sparsity settings.
Analyzed prediction error and feature selection stability across repeated data splits, documenting sensitivity to regularization choices and validation procedures.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Gaussian Mixture Estimation
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixture models in NumPy, including covariance regularization and alternative initialization strategies.
Compared clustering agreement and held-out likelihood with scikit-learn baselines, examining sensitivity to overlapping components and initialization.

projects.title: Kernel Methods for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented kernel ridge regression with linear and radial basis kernels, using nested cross-validation for hyperparameter selection.
Compared predictive error and residual patterns against polynomial regression and random forest baselines on synthetic nonlinear datasets.
